beats.say: Grand Theft Auto 6 lands on consoles on 19 November.
IGN notes even film directors fear its launch might distract audiences from major cinema releases.
Revealed back in December 2023, this open world adventure is set in the fictional state of Leonida.
Polygon reports that rumor mill interest is spiking around the actors behind its dual protagonists.
PC Gamer even highlighted another game delaying its launch to 2027 to avoid competing.
This release is so massive that other entire entertainment launches are shifting to stay clear. Gaming Shorts arrive every day, subscribe so you never miss one.
Mark 19 November: Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on consoles.
